system.description:
Found in the frozen great hall of the old PPS headquarters. Entries in a warm, hopeful hand grow colder page by page as the Frostbind curse takes hold: "They say friendship conquers all. Why can't it conquer this?"

The last entry: "I will prove it was always a lie." Reading it Spends Time and reveals the save-her path — and one true thing about each of her four friends.
